intro: Sour, salty and sweet home cooking shaped by Malay, Spanish, Chinese and American influences: vinegar braises, roast pork and big rice plates.
flavours: Vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, calamansi, bay leaf, coconut
hk: On Sundays, World-Wide House in Central is the hub of Hong Kong's Filipino community, with shops and Filipino food.

dishes.name: Chicken adobo
dishes.what: The unofficial national dish: chicken or pork braised in vinegar, soy, garlic and bay leaves.

dishes.name: Sinigang
dishes.what: Sour tamarind soup with pork or prawns and vegetables.

dishes.name: Lechon
dishes.what: Whole roast pig with glassy crackling skin, the centrepiece of every fiesta.

dishes.name: Sisig
dishes.what: Chopped pig's face and ears, crisped and served sizzling with chilli, onion and calamansi.

dishes.name: Pancit canton
dishes.what: Stir-fried egg noodles with vegetables and meat; noodles mean long life at birthdays.

dishes.name: Lumpia
dishes.what: Thin, crisp fried spring rolls filled with minced pork.

dishes.name: Kare-kare
dishes.what: Oxtail stew in thick peanut sauce, served with salty shrimp paste.

dishes.name: Halo-halo
dishes.what: 'Mix-mix': shaved ice layered with sweet beans, fruit, leche flan and purple ube ice cream.
